tests.name: 2-to-1 4-bit Mux
tests.setup: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y iverilog
tests.run: iverilog -o sim.vvp rtl/mux2.v tb/mux_2to1_4bit_tb.v && vvp sim.vvp | tee output.txt && grep -q 'TEST PASSED' output.txt
